Report Description
***WEB REPORT**A UTILITY POLE BLEW OVER DURING A SEVERE THUNDER STORM. THE POLE HAD A THREE SINGLE-PHASE TRANSFORMERS ATTACHED TO IT. TWO OF THESE THREE TRANSFORMERS WERE DAMAGED WHEN THE POLE TOP HIT THE GROUND. AN OIL SHEEN WAS OBSERVED AROUND A STORM DRAIN WHEN OUR CREW ARRIVED ONSITE. SUNPRO, A LOCAL SPILL CLEANUP CONTRACTOR, HAS BEEN CALLED IN TO CLEANUP THE RELEASED OIL.
